facts.business: ABM International Limited is an Indian listed company with no subsidiaries, engaged in activities involving non-fund based borrowings from Axis Bank and holding property as investment.
key_risks: Market value of certain long term investments in shares have eroded due to prevailing depressed market conditions
Debit/Credit balances of parties are subject to balance confirmation and reconciliation
facts.related_party_note: The company has not granted loans to promoters, directors, KMPs and related parties at any time during the year. There has been no related party transactions with regard to contribution to a trust controlled by the company in relation to CSR expenditure.
